original_case: How can we narrow a root without solving a cubic?
changed_condition: Now replace the curve with a jump from minus one to plus one.
viewer_inference: Continuity was the promise that made the bracket trustworthy. A sign change alone is not enough.
resolution: Bisection preserves a root under continuity and opposite endpoint signs; width halves per iteration. Discontinuity invalidates the guarantee.
prerequisite: Representations and operations introduced in this film
